result.rationale: Correct the existing Valley Cold record without duplicating Ridgewood's 2024 period. Ridgewood's official materials identify a Q4 2024 founder-led recapitalization attributable to Fund II, and the current company site identifies Clay and Jennifer Bush as owners. Their exact percentages, Ridgewood's stake and the legal SPV are not publicly disclosed and will not be inferred.
